_finding: The Base and Robinhood matrix puts two issuers' tokens of one share side by side. It must pair them by ISIN only (a symbol match pairs unrelated securities that share letters), compare each venue's premium over its own reference and never the raw prices (the multipliers and references differ), keep a stale reading out of the gaps, carry the reason when a premium is missing, and rank by the size of the gap.

mutations.name: paired by symbol instead of ISIN
mutations.expect: FAIL a look-alike symbol with another ISIN is not paired

mutations.name: raw prices compared instead of premiums
mutations.expect: FAIL the gap is the Robinhood premium minus the Base premium

mutations.name: the gap sign is reversed
mutations.expect: FAIL the gap is the Robinhood premium minus the Base premium

mutations.name: a stale reading enters the gap
mutations.expect: FAIL a reading older than 30 min is flagged stale and gets no gap

mutations.name: a missing premium loses its reason
mutations.expect: FAIL a missing premium carries its reason

mutations.name: rows are ranked by signed gap, not its size
mutations.expect: FAIL rows with a gap come first, the largest |gap| first

mutations.name: the reference age is the stored one, not computed against now
mutations.find:
const refAge = ref && ref.updated_at && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(ref.updated_at)) ? Math.max(0, Math.round((now - Date.parse(ref.updated_at)) / 1000)) : (ref?.age_s ?? null)
  const best = l && l.pools
mutations.replace:
const refAge = ref?.age_s ?? null
  const best = l && l.pools
mutations.expect: FAIL the reference age is computed against now, not the stored age
